description: RCA COSMAC CDP1802 instruction set used by the COSMAC VIP. 16-bit register architecture with 16 general-purpose 16-bit registers R0-RF, D accumulator, DF data flag, P program-counter selector, X data-pointer selector, Q output flip-flop, IE interrupt enable and T temporary register.
notes: CDP1802 has a 16-bit address space (64 KiB), byte-addressable memory, 16 x 16-bit registers, 8-bit D register, 1-bit DF, 1-bit Q and 1-bit IE. Any R register can be selected as P (program counter) or X (data pointer). Most instructions require 2 machine cycles; long branch/long skip/NOP require 3. One machine cycle consists of 8 clock periods. COSMAC VIP adds system-specific hardware such as the CDP1861 video interface; this JSON describes the CPU ISA, not the VIP video hardware or CHIP-8 interpreter.

schema.opcode: hex string/pattern; 8-bit opcode with N/register, MM/page-byte or KK/immediate placeholders
schema.words: integer; number of program bytes consumed (1, 2 or 3)
schema.group: category such as memory, register, branch, arithmetic, control, interrupt, io or skip
schema.operands: array of operand objects or null; each: {type, name, range, position}
schema.variants: optional; variant opcodes or parameters (null if none)

registers.DF: 1-bit data flag; carry/no-borrow indicator for arithmetic
registers.P: 4-bit selector identifying the program-counter register R(P)
registers.X: 4-bit selector identifying the data-pointer register R(X)
registers.T: 8-bit temporary register used by interrupt/return mechanisms

interrupts_and_dma.interrupt: On interrupt acceptance, T receives the current X/P state, X becomes 2, P becomes 1 and IE becomes 0.
interrupts_and_dma.dma_in: External DMA request transfers bus data to M(R0), then increments R0.
interrupts_and_dma.dma_out: External DMA request transfers M(R0) to the bus, then increments R0.
interrupts_and_dma.reset: Reset initializes the CPU control state according to the CDP1802 hardware specification.

instructions.semantics: CPU w stan IDLE (czeka na DMA/przerwanie)
